artifact: the Edit/Write diff to the Playwright config file
pattern: a hunk that changes the value of the `workers:` line away from the pinned 8
reason: the operative clause is 'workers: 8 stays' pending an owner decision; a config diff touching that key is a concrete pattern whose presence decides, no intent-reading needed

mechanism_target: CLAUDE.md and other derived/summary artifacts (indexes, agent briefs)
observed_prior_facts: whether the authoritative source document was actually Read (tool-log/state-store event) in this session before the derived artifact is written
reason: compliance = the source was opened and worked through before writing; that is a prior-event question observable in the tool log, not a pattern in the written file itself

deciding that a derived value has a real consumer that actually FIRES on real data requires understanding the render path's runtime meaning, not matching a reference textually — a dead reader still matches a grep

compliance = the fix was shown to fire via a changed error signature on reproduction; judging whether the observed signature change actually demonstrates the mechanism engaged is an evaluation of evidence meaning, not a textual pattern or a simple prior-event lookup

deciding whether a test asserts an observable behavioural effect versus a computed field, and whether a fixture is tailored to feed a broken gate, requires judging what the assertion and fixture MEAN, not their text shape

artifact: the Agent dispatch payload (the prompt field of the subagent brief)
pattern: a brief containing the full-suite command `npx playwright test` or an instruction to wait on / poll a backgrounded suite run
mechanism_target: subagent briefs referencing the full Playwright suite
reason: the rule forbids handing a subagent the suite wait outright; the suite command appearing in a dispatch prompt is a concrete textual pattern that decides without reading intent

mechanism_target: responses claiming a version is live / released
observed_prior_facts: whether a Playwright probe of the live URL verifying the shipped מהדורה stamp passed AFTER the most recent git push
reason: the claim's legitimacy depends entirely on what happened before it — push event followed by a passing live-URL verification — facts observable in the tool log / state store

deciding whether the deliverables bundled into one brief are 'unrelated/independent' requires judging the semantic relationship between tasks — no textual pattern in the brief distinguishes legitimate cohesion from over-bundling

cost: the gate described (clustered in-memory server, workers pinned to a measured ceiling) is a one-time architectural fix plus a measurement campaign already performed; enforcing it ongoing would mean continuously re-measuring server capacity under load, which no hook or gate can do cheaply
importance: בינונית — the record explains WHY the server architecture and worker pin exist, which protects against regression by ignorance, but it states a completed decision rather than an ongoing compliance condition

artifact: the Edit/Write diff introducing user-facing strings into the app source
pattern: a math/comparison glyph (`≥`, `≤`) or numeric readout added inside Hebrew RTL markup with no `dir="ltr"` attribute on the enclosing element, and no accompanying dir assertion in the test
reason: the gate is structural — LTR-island attribute present around math glyphs in Hebrew text — presence/absence of dir="ltr" near those characters is decidable without judging meaning

pattern: per-task fenced-code-block count of zero, or a truncation-inside-fence signature — exactly what `scripts/check-plan-complete.mjs` matches
reason: the rule already names its own mechanical detector: fenced-block counts and a truncation detector run on every generated plan before review

observed_prior_facts: whether a rendered-DOM measurement per language was executed (screenshots/DOM probes recorded in the tool log) before the claim was made
reason: the claim is only compliant if a specific prior measurement event exists; key-coverage counts in the artifact cannot decide it, but the prior rendered-DOM run is an observable fact

deciding that every sub-finding of a research document 'got a landing' requires judging which subsections inform decisions and whether each was meaningfully surfaced — a mapping of meaning between prose sections and phases, not a pattern or a counter

compliance = when a wait hangs on an idle machine, the debugger instrumented the boundary between layers before theorizing within one; assessing whether a debugging session followed that heuristic requires evaluating the intent and quality of the investigative approach

artifact: the tool call payload for code work — an Edit/Write (or Bash grep) invocation
pattern: an Edit|Write whose file_path is the app source (app.js) instead of a serena symbol operation; likewise a Bash `grep` over docs without a declared-fallback marker
reason: the rule mandates the TOOL itself (serena for code work); the choice of tool plus target file is a structural fact in the call payload that decides without reading intent — the grep-ordering clause is B-shaped but the core clause is pattern-decidable

mechanism_target: agent dispatches under the §10.5a concurrency ceiling
observed_prior_facts: the count of currently-running agents, their light/heavy class, and whether a suite run, build, or GPU queue is active — all held in the session state store / dispatch journal
reason: a single dispatch payload cannot decide compliance; the caps (≤3 light, hard 5, one heavy during a suite) depend entirely on what is already running

artifact: the repository state at commit/push time — `git status --short` output
pattern: a modified tracked file left unstaged while a commit/push proceeds and reports success
mechanism_target: git commit / the docs-sync script's push
reason: the gate the rule states is mechanical: diff the staged set against modified tracked files and warn on any leftover — presence of an unstaged-modified line decides, no intent needed

deciding that a plan instruction to delete/revert something is STALE requires judging what the instruction means against the current tree — whether the target 'has since shipped' is a semantic comparison of intent-at-writing versus present truth, not a pattern match

compliance = a surprising measurement was validated by proving the probe actually ran the workload; judging whether a result is 'surprising' and whether the validation evidence suffices is an evaluation of measurement quality, not a pattern or counter
